This maize plot is small but it is close to my home, so I take care of it well. I will put some DAP and urea like the cooperative gives us, though I cannot afford the full package — cash is tight. I spread manure from my cattle on it too because the soil needs strength, and I keep my own seed from last season since improved seed is expensive and the local variety does well for me. My wife and I will weed it ourselves, maybe I call a neighbor for one or two days at harvest.
